cases.expected: Reject startup before WAL or migration can mutate the database
cases.observed: The preflight contract rejected unmanaged and unknown revisions without changing the database; a known 0001 database was backed up and upgraded through 0002.

cases.case: exception between immutable snapshot and decision writes
cases.expected: Commit all business evidence together or commit none of it
cases.observed: The injected exception rolled back snapshot, decision, and reference rows as one short transaction.

cases.case: process crash inside an evidence transaction
cases.expected: SQLite recovery must not expose a half-committed business revision
cases.observed: A child process terminated during the transaction; reopening the database showed no partial snapshot or decision.

cases.expected: Reject restore, leave the target retryable, and remove staging
cases.observed: Restore rejected the incomplete manifest, the target remained empty or absent, staging was removed, and a corrected backup restored successfully to the same target.

cases.case: active hold without a business reference
cases.expected: Backup and cleanup must still protect the held evidence
cases.observed: The backup contained the hold-only blob and restore verified its identity and bytes.

cases.case: cleanup claim races with a new reference
cases.expected: A newly referenced blob must not be deleted
cases.observed: The short transaction rechecked protection before deletion and preserved the evidence after the competing reference committed.

cases.case: expired lease from a stopped or crashed instance
cases.expected: Recover only with matching data-root and operating-system ownership proof
cases.observed: The matching replacement reclaimed the expired lease and rotated the fencing token; active, unexpired, wrong-root, and current-instance cases were rejected.

cases.case: stale or expired scheduler result grant
cases.expected: Reject the result with zero database writes
cases.observed: Stale token, stale generation, wrong process identity, released lease, takeover, and expired lease all raised a fencing error without a result, checkpoint, or lease mutation.

cases.expected: Fence old navigation authority before automatic control resumes
cases.observed: Recovery required the full proof set and issued a new epoch and token; old, released, expired, and wrong-owner navigation tokens were rejected.

cases.case: human browser control held over time
cases.expected: Elapsed time must never authorize automated navigation
cases.observed: Human login and handoff modes remained protected until an explicit matching return; no TTL-based reclaim occurred.

cases.expected: Consume one global retry before failing consumers
cases.observed: One safe retry was created globally and later success was consumed once by each active consumer.

cases.expected: Create one replacement producer and never bypass the retry budget
cases.observed: Concurrent requests converged on one production attempt; new idempotency keys could not exceed the shared retry budget.

cases.expected: Propagate one technical cause once per consumer and never create finance review
cases.observed: Each active consumer received the same terminal technical failure exactly once, with no BusinessOutcome or human-review item.

cases.case: application shutdown during an atomic scheduler tick
cases.expected: Wait for the atomic tick, stop owned workers, then abandon only uncommitted attempts
cases.observed: Scheduler close waited without a timeout, owned workers stopped first, committed results remained, and only the current uncommitted attempt was requeued.

cases.case: supervisor process exits with an owned child
cases.expected: Stop only the registered child and never an unknown process
cases.observed: The Windows Job Object terminated the owned helper; identity mismatch and unknown-process tests did not terminate unrelated processes.
